sessions.focus: Full body, push and hinge emphasis; shallow-range knee-dominant work only (knee-safe)
Full body, pull and single-leg/hip emphasis; loaded carry for conditioning (knee-safe)
Full body, balanced push/pull with higher-density circuit-style finish for energy expenditure

payload.periodization_notes: Weeks 1-2 introduce movement patterns at moderate effort with ample reps in reserve; weeks 3-6 add volume then load progressively (linear progression); week 7 is peak effort and week 8 is a lighter consolidation/deload. Keep knee flexion shallow-to-moderate throughout and use shorter rest or circuit density, rather than deeper ranges, to raise energy expenditure for fat loss.
